source_documents.title: NGHE autonomous construction unstructured test text

source_units.text: The integrated control center set the goal of finishing at least about 38,000 m3 of earthwork during the first 72 h.
The site maintenance team installed BSS_T, ESS_T, and SCS and confirmed the RTDD latency and HSM authentication.
DMSS and ASPCS created the terrain data, and AI_ICP received approval for the start in Level 3 supervised autonomy mode.
After 2 h had passed, when all indicators came within the normal range, the transition to Level 4 full autonomy mode was approved.
The battery SoC of U-EEX Unit 1 reached 15%, so it entered Eco Mode and then autonomously returned to BSS_T.
When visibility dropped to 200 m or less and the sensor confidence score dropped, AI_ICP proposed lowering from Level 4 to Level 3.
The HSM of U-EEX Unit 3 detected the forged digital signature of the received command packet, and the security system blocked the external public network.
When the heavy rain intensified, the remote supervisor issued a forced work stop command, and all equipment switched to Level 1 emergency stop mode.
After the site supervisor completed the safety inspection, the remote supervisor approved construction resumption in Level 3 and afterward approved the transition to Level 4 again.
At the final 72 h mission completion point, the cumulative earthwork volume became about 38,200 m3, meeting the target of 38,000 m3.
